description.value: Sol Fine Foods is a scratch-kitchen cafe and deli on the Selkirk Waterfront in Victoria, serving locally sourced breakfast and lunch made with Berryman's meats, farm-fresh eggs, and produce from regional suppliers. Coffee is roasted by The Stick in the Mud Roastoreum, and the daily fresh sheet rotates hot specials alongside staple sandwiches, burgers, soups, and baked goods. Indoor dining and a sun-bathed patio are available, along with catering and online ordering for fresh and frozen take-home provisions.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: wave (5 spaces) at 34m; wave (5 spaces) at 79m; wave (5 spaces) at 96m. Total: 15 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates the OSM record for address and phone. The site confirms online ordering with pickup, delivery, and dine-in options, establishing takeout. Vegetarian options (veggie burger, falafel bowl, protein bowl accommodating vegetarian) are documented across menu subpages. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site. One concern: the OSM email (shaw.ca) differs from the email shown on the website (gmail.com).
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists Solfinefoods@shaw.ca but the website consistently shows solfinefoods@gmail.com as the contact email.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active cafe and deli on the Selkirk Waterfront with takeout, patio, varied menu including vegetarian options, and online ordering — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Vegetarian options confirmed across menus: Veggie Burger, Falafel Greek Bowl, Spinach-Mushroom Lasagna, Mexi-Black Bean Avocado Burrito, and protein bowls note 'can accommodate vegetarian.' No explicit vegan or GF claims found
